The San Antonio Spurs have won 10 straight games! Watch the best plays from the win streak.
San Antonio most recently beat the Bulls, 124-119, after trailing by 22. Victor Wembanyama is averaging 32.6 points, 11.4 rebounds and 4.5 blocks per game during the streak, and the Spurs are outscoring opponents by 15.0 points on average, with 1,216 points scored and 1,066 allowed.
